description: Wall with two lives. (1) SEGMENT-hosted (Segment Properties): the wall takes the segment's length and its CANVAS thickness as the footprint — `length`/`thickness`/`miterA`/`miterB`/`hatch` are ignored there (the renderer builds the band from the host segment, mitered at joints) and only `height`/`base`/`color` apply. Unlike Door/Window objects it does NOT cut an opening in the segment. (2) COMPOSED as a child (`ref` from another object, e.g. the Floorplan's walls): draws a straight wall run — `length × thickness` in plan, extruded `base → base + height` — centred on its origin, run along local X, drawn as a POCHÉ band with 45° hatch lines (`hatch`, 2D only). `miterA`/`miterB` cut the two ends for MITRED corner joints (−1 / 0 / +1): +1 extends the +Y corner and retracts the −Y corner by thickness/2 (0 = square butt); two perpendicular walls with matching ±1 cuts meet on the corner diagonal with no overlap, in plan AND in 3D (the prism footprint is the mitred trapezoid). Cuts are thickness-RELATIVE, so overriding one wall's thickness keeps its joints consistent. Composing parents typically HARD-bind length + miters (the plan owns the layout/joints) and SOFT-bind thickness/height, so each wall instance stays individually tunable from the Components editor.

vars._doc: Mitred band: at end A the +Y corner sits at −L/2 − miterA·t/2 and the −Y corner at −L/2 + miterA·t/2 (mirrored at end B), so ±1 gives a 45° end cut whose diagonal matches a perpendicular neighbour's. Hatch: 45° lines every `hs` across the straight middle of the band (kept clear of the cut ends), 2D only.
